focus: Ghana tax-benefit surface: national income tax (PAYE and self-assessment), personal reliefs, social contributions, and cash-transfer / social-protection programmes.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Ghana Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: GHAMOD
oracles.dataset: gh_2013_a8.txt, gh_2017_a8.txt (GLSS-based input microdata shipped in the bundle)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Ghana, wired through per-case suites in axiom-oracles (see wired). GHAMOD is the SOUTHMOD tax-benefit microsimulation model for Ghana (UNU-WIDER), built on the EUROMOD platform.

availability_check.detail: UNU-WIDER approved the SOUTHMOD access request on 2026-07-07; the model bundle (SOUTHMOD A4.0, sha256 above) is held locally under the SOUTHMOD_A4.0 Adhesion Agreement (personal links; non-redistributable; never committed or shared). GHAMOD is wired as the Ghana household oracle by nine per-case comparison suites in TheAxiomFoundation/axiom-oracles (comparisons/gh-*.yaml, axiom-oracles#205 to #221), run on system GH_2025 through scripts/run_comparison.py on the licensed machine. They are manual-lane suites (ci: manual): clause 4 of the agreement bars giving the bundle or its input data to any third party, so they never run on shared CI runners. On 2026-10-04, against rulespec-gh 4d84b15 and axiom-rules-engine 6f62c12: 39 cases, 47 comparisons, 46 matched and 1 dispositioned (at 700,000 GHAMOD omits the Act 1111 35% band; the GHAMOD maintainers confirmed this on 2026-07-16 and said the next release fixes it). Oracle-side findings are recorded in axiom-oracles axiom_oracles/data/ghamod_issues.json. The rulespec-gh modules these suites compare carry manual-attestation manifests, so the comparisons should be re-run after any supervised re-encode.

oracles.systems: GH_2013 through GH_2025 (13 policy years; the wired suites run GH_2025)

wired.dataset_configuration: gh_2017_a8 (variable list only; every comparison household is synthetic)

suites.note: Regression check, not a rate test: both sides use the every-weekday day count (365 x 5/7) implied by GHAMOD's observed bed_s (521.43 a year = 2.00 x 260.71 days), so a rate error and a calendar error cannot be told apart.
